drivingQuestion: Which inclination rules a man — and what does it mean to be one of the middling?
outcomeNote: A chain of tannaitic and amoraic dicta on the organs and the inclinations; nothing is put to proof except Abaye's protest to Rabba, which is left standing without an answer.

segments.he: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: כְּלָיוֹת יוֹעֲצוֹת, לֵב מֵבִין, לָשׁוֹן מְחַתֵּךְ, פֶּה גּוֹמֵר, וֶשֶׁט מַכְנִיס וּמוֹצִיא כׇּל מִינֵי מַאֲכָל, קָנֶה מוֹצִיא קוֹל,
segments.en: Tangential to the subject of kidneys, the Gemara cites that which «the Sages taught» in a baraita with regard to the roles of various organs: «The kidneys advise, the heart understands, the tongue shapes» the sounds that emerges from the mouth, the «mouth completes» the shaping of the voice, the «esophagus takes in and lets out all kinds of food,» the «trachea produces the voice,»

segments.he: רֵיאָה שׁוֹאֶבֶת כׇּל מִינֵי מַשְׁקִין, כָּבֵד כּוֹעֵס, מָרָה זוֹרֶקֶת בּוֹ טִפָּה וּמְנִיחָתוֹ, טְחוֹל שׂוֹחֵק, קֻרְקְבָן טוֹחֵן, קֵיבָה יְשֵׁנָה, אַף נֵעוֹר. נֵעוֹר הַיָּשֵׁן יָשֵׁן הַנֵּעוֹר — נִמּוֹק וְהוֹלֵךְ לוֹ. תָּנָא: אִם שְׁנֵיהֶם יְשֵׁנִים אוֹ שְׁנֵיהֶם נֵעוֹרִים — מִיָּד מֵת.
segments.en: and the «lungs draw all kinds of liquids,» the «liver becomes angry,» the «gall» bladder «injects a drop» of gall «into» the liver and «allays» anger, the «spleen laughs,» the «maw grinds» the food, and the «stomach» brings «sleep,» the «nose awakens.» If they reversed roles such that «the» organ which brings on «sleep» were to «awaken,» or «the» organ which «awakens» were to bring on «sleep,» the individual «would gradually deteriorate. It was taught: If both» bring on «sleep or both awaken,» the person «immediately dies.»

segments.he: תַּנְיָא רַבִּי יוֹסֵי הַגְּלִילִי אוֹמֵר: צַדִּיקִים יֵצֶר טוֹב שׁוֹפְטָן, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְלִבִּי חָלַל בְּקִרְבִּי״. רְשָׁעִים יֵצֶר רַע שׁוֹפְטָן, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״נְאֻם פֶּשַׁע לָרָשָׁע בְּקֶרֶב לִבִּי אֵין פַּחַד אֱלֹהִים לְנֶגֶד עֵינָיו״. בֵּינוֹנִים — זֶה וָזֶה שׁוֹפְטָן, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״יַעֲמֹד לִימִין אֶבְיוֹן לְהוֹשִׁיעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵי נַפְשׁוֹ״.
segments.en: With regard to one’s inclinations, «it was taught» in a baraita that «Rabbi Yosei HaGelili says: The good inclination rules the righteous, as it is stated: “And my heart is dead within me”» (Psalms 109:22); the evil inclination has been completely banished from his heart. The «evil inclination rules the wicked, as it is stated: “Transgression speaks to the wicked, there is no fear of God before his eyes”» (Psalms 36:2). «Middling people are ruled by both» the good and evil inclinations, «as it is stated: “Because He stands at the right hand of the needy, to save him from them that rule his soul”» (Psalms 109:31).

segments.he: אָמַר רַבָּה: כְּגוֹן אָנוּ בֵּינוֹנִים. אָמַר לֵיהּ אַבָּיֵי: לָא שָׁבֵיק מָר חַיֵּי לְכׇל בְּרִיָּה?
segments.en: «Rabba said:» People «like us» are «middling. Abaye,» his student and nephew, «said to him:» If «the Master» claims that he is merely middling, he «does not leave» room for «any creature to live.» If a person like you is middling, what of the rest of us?

segments.he: וְאָמַר רָבָא: לָא אִיבְּרִי עָלְמָא אֶלָּא לְרַשִּׁיעֵי גְּמוּרֵי אוֹ לְצַדִּיקֵי גְּמוּרֵי. אָמַר רָבָא: לִידַּע אִינָשׁ בְּנַפְשֵׁיהּ אִם צַדִּיק גָּמוּר הוּא אִם לָאו. אָמַר רַב: לָא אִיבְּרִי עָלְמָא אֶלָּא לְאַחְאָב בֶּן עָמְרִי וּלְרַבִּי חֲנִינָא בֶּן דּוֹסָא. לְאַחְאָב בֶּן עָמְרִי — הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה, וּלְרַבִּי חֲנִינָא בֶּן דּוֹסָא — הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא.
segments.en: «And Rava said: The world was created only for» the sake of «the full-fledged wicked or the full-fledged righteous;» others do not live complete lives in either world. «Rava said: One should know of himself whether or not he is completely righteous,» as if he is not completely righteous, he knows that his life will be a life of suffering. «Rav said: The world was only created for» the wicked «Ahab ben Omri and for Rabbi Ḥanina ben Dosa.» The Gemara explains: For «Ahab ben Omri, this world» was created, as he has no place in the World-to-Come, «and» for «Rabbi Ḥanina ben Dosa, the World-to-Come» was created.

moves.about: the baraita listing the offices of the body's organs, brought because the kidneys were just mentioned

moves.cueHe: תנא: אם שניהם ישנים או שניהם נעורים
moves.summary: a further tannaitic clause: if the sleeping and waking organs both do the same, death is immediate
moves.about: a further tannaitic clause: if both the sleep-organ and the waking-organ do the same, the person dies at once

moves.cueHe: תניא רבי יוסי הגלילי אומר: צדיקים יצר טוב שופטן
moves.summary: a baraita divides mankind into righteous, wicked and middling by which inclination rules them
moves.about: the prooftext that the righteous man's heart is dead within him, the evil inclination banished

moves.summary: Rabba puts himself in the baraita's middling category
moves.about: placing himself and his circle in the baraita's category of the middling, ruled by both inclinations

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה אביי: לא שביק מר חיי לכל בריה
moves.summary: Abaye objects that this would leave no creature alive
moves.about: whether a man of Rabba's stature may call himself merely middling, since that would leave no one alive

moves.cueHe: ואמר רבא: לא איברי עלמא אלא לרשיעי גמורי
moves.summary: the world was created only for the wholly wicked or the wholly righteous
moves.about: Rava's two dicta — the world was created only for the wholly wicked or the wholly righteous, and a man should know which he is

moves.summary: a man should know of himself whether or not he is wholly righteous
